definition: The town where you were born or grew up.
examples: I go back to my hometown every summer.
My hometown is very small.
She moved away from her hometown at eighteen.

spanish.definition: Pueblo donde naciste o creciste.

definition: The way a person lives.
examples: He has a very healthy lifestyle.
Moving to the country changed our lifestyle.
She can't afford that lifestyle.

spanish.definition: Manera en que vive una persona.

definition: A Japanese dish of cold rice with raw fish.
examples: We had sushi for dinner.
I've never tried sushi.
There's a great sushi place downtown.

spanish.definition: Plato japonés de arroz frío con pescado crudo.

definition: A person who takes care of children while their parents are out.
examples: We need a babysitter for Saturday night.
The babysitter put the kids to bed.
She worked as a babysitter in high school.

spanish.definition: Persona que cuida a los niños mientras los padres salen.

definition: All over the world.
examples: The company sells its products worldwide.
The song was a worldwide hit.
Millions of people worldwide speak English.

spanish.definition: Por todo el mundo.

definition: A Mexican food of a folded tortilla with meat and vegetables.
examples: I ordered two beef tacos.
We have tacos every Tuesday.
This taco is really spicy.

spanish.definition: Comida mexicana de tortilla doblada con carne y verduras.

definition: A website where someone writes regularly about a subject.
examples: She writes a travel blog.
I read about it on a food blog.
He started a blog about his garden.

spanish.definition: Sitio web donde alguien escribe regularmente sobre un tema.

definition: A place to dance and drink at night.
examples: They went dancing at a nightclub.
He works at a nightclub downtown.
The nightclub stays open until 3 a.m.

spanish.definition: Lugar para bailar y tomar por la noche.

definition: An apartment that you own.
examples: They bought a condo in Miami.
My parents have a condo near the beach.
The condo has two bedrooms.

spanish.definition: Apartamento del que eres dueño.

definition: A thick, creamy food made from milk.
examples: I eat yogurt with fruit for breakfast.
This strawberry yogurt is delicious.
We're out of yogurt.

spanish.definition: Comida espesa y cremosa hecha de leche.

definition: A company that flies planes for passengers.
examples: Which airline are you flying with?
The airline lost my bag.
She's a pilot for a big airline.

spanish.definition: Empresa que vuela aviones con pasajeros.

definition: To copy a file from the internet to your device.
examples: I downloaded the app on my phone.
The download will take five minutes.
Can you download this song for me?

spanish.definition: Copiar un archivo de internet a tu aparato.

definition: The sick feeling you have after drinking too much alcohol.
examples: He woke up with a terrible hangover.
I have a hangover from last night.
Water helps with a hangover.

spanish.definition: Malestar que sientes después de tomar demasiado alcohol.

definition: A quicker way to get somewhere or do something.
examples: I know a shortcut to the beach.
There's no shortcut to success.
We took a shortcut through the park.

spanish.definition: Manera más rápida de llegar a un lugar o de hacer algo.

definition: A room with a toilet in a public place.
examples: Where's the restroom, please?
The restroom is at the back of the store.
I need to use the restroom.

spanish.definition: Cuarto con inodoro en un lugar público.

definition: Counting backward to zero before an event.
examples: The countdown to New Year's has started.
The countdown for the rocket began.
Everyone joined the countdown at midnight.

spanish.definition: Contar hacia atrás hasta cero antes de un evento.

definition: The money you get for your work, usually every two weeks.
examples: I got my first paycheck today.
We live from paycheck to paycheck.
Half of my paycheck goes to rent.

spanish.definition: Dinero que recibes por tu trabajo, normalmente cada dos semanas.

definition: A system that records phone messages.
examples: I left you a voicemail.
My call went to voicemail.
Check your voicemail when you can.

spanish.definition: Sistema que graba mensajes de teléfono.

definition: The time of day when you eat lunch.
examples: The store is busy at lunchtime.
It's almost lunchtime.
I'll call you at lunchtime.

spanish.definition: Momento del día en que almuerzas.

definition: A soft substance you use to clean your teeth.
examples: We're out of toothpaste.
This toothpaste tastes like mint.
Put some toothpaste on your toothbrush.

spanish.definition: Sustancia suave que usas para limpiar los dientes.

definition: A figure of a person made of snow.
examples: The kids built a snowman in the yard.
We gave the snowman a carrot nose.
The snowman melted in the sun.

spanish.definition: Figura de una persona hecha de nieve.

definition: A short board with four wheels that you stand on.
examples: He rides his skateboard to school.
She fell off her skateboard.
My son got a skateboard for Christmas.

spanish.definition: Tabla corta con cuatro ruedas sobre la que te paras.

definition: A warm, soft shirt with long sleeves.
examples: I put on a sweatshirt because it was cold.
She wore her college sweatshirt.
This sweatshirt has a hood.

spanish.definition: Camisa cálida y suave de mangas largas.

definition: Food you buy at a restaurant and eat somewhere else.
examples: Let's get Chinese takeout tonight.
We ordered takeout because I was tired.
This pizza place only does takeout.

spanish.definition: Comida que compras en un restaurante y comes en otro lugar.

definition: Strange because it is the opposite of what you expect.
examples: It's ironic that the doctor is a smoker.
She gave an ironic smile.
The ironic thing is that he's a banker who hates money.

spanish.definition: Raro porque es lo contrario de lo que esperas.

definition: Having no job.
examples: He's been unemployed for six months.
Many people are unemployed here.
She helps unemployed people find work.

spanish.definition: Sin trabajo.

definition: A brother or a sister.
examples: Do you have any siblings?
I have three siblings.
She's very close to her siblings.

spanish.definition: Un hermano o una hermana.

definition: Happening soon.
examples: We're getting ready for the upcoming election.
What are your upcoming plans?
The band is planning an upcoming tour.

spanish.definition: Que pasará pronto.

definition: Friendly and happy to meet new people.
examples: She's very outgoing.
My brother is an outgoing guy.
Outgoing people make friends easily.

spanish.definition: Amistoso y contento de conocer gente nueva.

definition: The way a person writes by hand.
examples: I can't read your handwriting.
She has beautiful handwriting.
The note was in my father's handwriting.

spanish.definition: Manera en que una persona escribe a mano.

definition: The pipes that carry water in a building.
examples: The plumbing in this house is old.
We have a plumbing problem.
They're fixing the plumbing in the bathroom.

spanish.definition: Tubos que llevan el agua en un edificio.

definition: Putting a lot of effort into your work.
examples: She's a very hardworking student.
My parents are hardworking people.
He's honest and hardworking.

spanish.definition: Que pone mucho esfuerzo en su trabajo.

definition: The activity of visiting interesting places as a tourist.
examples: We went sightseeing in Rome.
We did a lot of sightseeing on our trip.
Let's go sightseeing tomorrow.

spanish.definition: Actividad de visitar lugares interesantes como turista.

definition: To run slowly for exercise.
examples: I jog every morning.
She jogged around the lake.
He goes jogging after work.

spanish.definition: Correr despacio para hacer ejercicio.

definition: To move over snow on long, narrow boards; one of these boards.
examples: We ski in Colorado every winter.
She skied down the mountain.
He broke one of his skis.

spanish.definition: Moverse sobre la nieve con tablas largas y estrechas; una de estas tablas.

definition: Not completed.
examples: He left the work unfinished.
The house is still unfinished.
I have some unfinished business here.

spanish.definition: Que no se ha completado.

definition: To make someone feel upset because they can't do something.
examples: This computer frustrates me.
The traffic really frustrated him.
It's frustrating when nobody listens.

spanish.definition: Hacer que alguien se sienta molesto porque no puede hacer algo.

definition: To make someone feel less tired; to update a web page.
examples: A cold shower will refresh you.
Refresh the page to see the new results.
The long nap refreshed me.

spanish.definition: Hacer que alguien se sienta menos cansado; actualizar una página web.

definition: To give someone too much to handle; to affect someone very strongly.
examples: All the work overwhelmed me.
She was overwhelmed with joy.
Don't overwhelm the kids with too many rules.

spanish.definition: Darle a alguien demasiado que manejar; afectar a alguien con mucha fuerza.

definition: Old and no longer useful.
examples: This map is outdated.
He has some very outdated ideas.
The school uses outdated computers.

spanish.definition: Viejo y ya no útil.

definition: To join cloth with a needle and thread.
examples: My grandmother taught me to sew.
She sewed a button on my shirt.
I'm sewing a dress for my daughter.

spanish.definition: Unir tela con aguja e hilo.

definition: To make someone a little angry.
examples: His loud music annoys me.
She gets annoyed easily.
Stop annoying your sister.

spanish.definition: Hacer enojar un poco a alguien.

definition: An object used by actors in a play or a movie.
examples: The gun in the movie was just a prop.
He takes care of the props for the school play.
The stage was full of props.

spanish.definition: Objeto que usan los actores en una obra o una película.

definition: To fix something that is broken or torn.
examples: She mended the hole in his sock.
He's trying to mend his relationship with his dad.
Can you mend this shirt?

spanish.definition: Arreglar algo roto o rasgado.

definition: To use someone or something in an unfair way.
examples: The company exploits its workers.
Don't let people exploit you.
They exploited her kindness.

spanish.definition: Usar a alguien o algo de forma injusta.

definition: A small desert animal with a dangerous sting in its tail.
examples: A scorpion stung him on the foot.
Check your shoes for scorpions.
We found a scorpion under a rock.

spanish.definition: Animal pequeño del desierto con un aguijón peligroso en la cola.

definition: The edge of a sidewalk next to the street.
examples: He parked next to the curb.
She tripped on the curb.
Put the trash out at the curb on Monday.

spanish.definition: Borde de la acera junto a la calle.

definition: Strong and good at sports.
examples: He's tall and athletic.
She has an athletic body.
I bought some athletic shoes.

spanish.definition: Fuerte y bueno para los deportes.

definition: A class or a meeting for a small group.
examples: I'm going to a sales seminar in Dallas.
She teaches a history seminar.
The seminar lasts all day.

spanish.definition: Clase o reunión para un grupo pequeño.

definition: The level of confidence in a group.
examples: Team morale is high after the win.
The pay cuts hurt morale.
His speech lifted the soldiers' morale.

spanish.definition: Nivel de confianza en un grupo.

definition: A careful judgment of how good something is.
examples: I have my job evaluation on Friday.
Students filled out a teacher evaluation.
The doctor did a full evaluation.

spanish.definition: Juicio cuidadoso sobre qué tan bueno es algo.

definition: The quality of being very exact.
examples: The machine cuts with great precision.
This job requires precision.
She drew the map with precision.

spanish.definition: Cualidad de ser muy exacto.

definition: A solid shape with six equal square sides.
examples: Put an ice cube in my drink.
Cut the cheese into small cubes.
A cube has six sides.

spanish.definition: Figura sólida con seis lados cuadrados iguales.

definition: A surprising fact that people learn.
examples: The book has some shocking revelations.
It was a revelation to me.
Her revelation surprised the whole family.

spanish.definition: Hecho sorprendente que la gente descubre.

definition: A person who pays rent for a place.
examples: The tenant didn't pay the rent.
We're looking for a new tenant.
The building has twenty tenants.

spanish.definition: Persona que paga alquiler por un lugar.

definition: Happening every second time; different from the usual one.
examples: We meet on alternate Fridays.
Take an alternate route to avoid the traffic.
I need an alternate plan.

spanish.definition: Que pasa una vez sí y otra no; distinto del habitual.

definition: Hard work and commitment to something.
examples: Her dedication to her students is amazing.
It takes years of dedication to be a pianist.
We thank him for his dedication.

spanish.definition: Trabajo duro y compromiso con algo.

definition: Having a bad smell.
examples: Take off your smelly socks.
The bus was hot and smelly.
That cheese is really smelly.

spanish.definition: Con mal olor.

definition: A long, narrow hole in the ground.
examples: The workers dug a trench for the pipes.
Soldiers lived in the trenches.
He's wearing a long trench coat.

spanish.definition: Hueco largo y estrecho en el suelo.

definition: The chance that something will happen.
examples: The job has good prospects.
There's no prospect of peace.
I hate the prospect of moving again.

spanish.definition: Posibilidad de que algo pase.

definition: A cure or a way to solve a problem.
examples: My grandmother has a home remedy for colds.
Is there a remedy for this problem?
Hot tea is a good remedy for a sore throat.

spanish.definition: Cura o manera de resolver un problema.

definition: The top part of your leg.
examples: He hurt his thigh in the game.
I prefer chicken thighs.
The water came up to my thighs.

spanish.definition: Parte de arriba de la pierna.

definition: A statement that someone did something wrong.
examples: That's a very serious accusation.
He denied the accusations.
She made a false accusation against him.

spanish.definition: Declaración de que alguien hizo algo malo.

definition: Spoken; connected to the mouth.
examples: We have an oral exam tomorrow.
Good oral health is important.
She gave an oral report to the class.

spanish.definition: Hablado; relacionado con la boca.

definition: A piece of cloth you wear to keep clothes clean while cooking.
examples: He put on an apron and started cooking.
The waitress wore a black apron.
She wiped her hands on her apron.

spanish.definition: Tela que te pones para mantener limpia la ropa al cocinar.

definition: A tube that carries blood to the heart.
examples: The nurse couldn't find a vein.
You can see the veins in his arm.
Blood travels through your veins.

spanish.definition: Tubo que lleva la sangre al corazón.

definition: Rising or falling sharply.
examples: The hill is very steep.
We climbed a steep road.
Those prices are a little steep.

spanish.definition: Que sube o baja de forma brusca.

definition: Too much of a drug taken at one time.
examples: He died of a drug overdose.
She took an overdose of sleeping pills.
The hospital treats many overdoses.

spanish.definition: Demasiada droga tomada de una vez.

definition: A formal word for a car.
examples: Henry Ford built automobiles.
He works in the automobile industry.
The automobile changed American life.

spanish.definition: Palabra formal para un carro.

definition: A small sweet cake; dough used for pies.
examples: We had coffee and a pastry.
She's a pastry chef.
This pastry is filled with cream.

spanish.definition: Pastel pequeño y dulce; masa usada para tartas.

definition: A person who comes after another in a job.
examples: Who will be the president's successor?
He chose his son as his successor.
Her successor starts in March.

spanish.definition: Persona que sigue a otra en un trabajo.

definition: A person who leads the crowd in cheering at a game.
examples: She's a cheerleader at her high school.
The cheerleaders danced at halftime.
He's always been my biggest cheerleader.

spanish.definition: Persona que anima al público en un juego.

definition: Not planned.
examples: The fire was accidental.
It was an accidental discovery.
He suffered an accidental injury.

spanish.definition: Que no fue planeado.

definition: A small cake for one person.
examples: She made chocolate cupcakes for the party.
I had a cupcake with pink frosting.
The bakery sells great cupcakes.

spanish.definition: Pastel pequeño para una persona.

definition: A type of Christian music; the teachings of Jesus.
examples: She sings in a gospel choir.
He preached the gospel.
I love gospel music.

spanish.definition: Tipo de música cristiana; enseñanzas de Jesús.

definition: Probably true, based on what you know.
examples: He's not here, presumably because he's sick.
Presumably, the store is closed on Sundays.
She'll presumably call us when she arrives.

spanish.definition: Probablemente cierto, según lo que sabes.

definition: Something you believe is true without proof.
examples: Don't make assumptions about people.
I made the assumption that you were coming.
That's a dangerous assumption.

spanish.definition: Algo que crees que es verdad sin prueba.

definition: A sea animal with a long body and ten arms.
examples: We ordered fried squid.
A giant squid lives in the deep sea.
The squid was fresh and delicious.

spanish.definition: Animal de mar de cuerpo largo con diez brazos.

definition: A wide, fast road.
examples: The freeway is always busy at five.
Take the freeway to downtown.
There was an accident on the freeway.

spanish.definition: Carretera ancha y rápida.

definition: A very strong, spinning wind.
examples: A tornado hit the town last night.
The tornado destroyed many homes.
Kansas gets a lot of tornadoes.

spanish.definition: Viento muy fuerte que gira.

definition: A small problem that causes trouble.
examples: We're sorry for the inconvenience.
The delay was a big inconvenience.
It's no inconvenience at all.

spanish.definition: Problema pequeño que causa dificultades.

definition: A small, sweet, purple fruit.
examples: I ate a plum with my lunch.
We have a plum tree in the garden.
She made a plum cake.

spanish.definition: Fruta pequeña, dulce y morada.

definition: Clearly different; easy to notice.
examples: There are two distinct groups.
The soup has a distinct taste of garlic.
I had the distinct feeling he was lying.

spanish.definition: Claramente diferente; fácil de notar.

definition: In addition.
examples: The car is old; furthermore, it isn't safe.
He's smart. Furthermore, he works hard.
Furthermore, we need more time.

spanish.definition: También.

definition: Something you must have.
examples: A car is a necessity here.
Food and water are basic necessities.
We sold the house out of necessity.

spanish.definition: Algo que debes tener.

definition: Being completely sure.
examples: I can't say with certainty.
It's a certainty that prices will rise.
There's no certainty he'll come.

spanish.definition: Estar completamente seguro.

definition: Standing or sitting up straight.
examples: Please keep your seat upright.
She sat upright in bed.
They stood the piano upright.

spanish.definition: Parado o sentado derecho.

definition: An old machine for writing with keys.
examples: My grandfather wrote his books on a typewriter.
I found an old typewriter in the attic.
She still uses a typewriter.

spanish.definition: Máquina vieja para escribir con teclas.

definition: A wild North American animal like a small wolf.
examples: We heard coyotes at night.
A coyote ran across the road.
Coyotes sometimes eat small pets.

spanish.definition: Animal salvaje de Norteamérica parecido a un lobo pequeño.

definition: To bend your knees and sit on your heels.
examples: She squatted to talk to the child.
He was squatting next to the fire.
I can squat 200 pounds at the gym.

spanish.definition: Doblar las rodillas y sentarse sobre los talones.

definition: To remove something by rubbing with a hard edge; to hurt your skin by rubbing it.
examples: I scraped the ice off the car.
She scraped her knee when she fell.
He's scraping the paint off the wall.

spanish.definition: Quitar algo frotando con un borde duro; lastimarte la piel al rozarla.

definition: Normal and traditional.
examples: We use a conventional oven.
He has very conventional ideas.
She didn't want a conventional wedding.

spanish.definition: Normal y tradicional.

definition: The act of buying or selling something.
examples: Your credit card transaction was declined.
The bank charges a fee for each transaction.
We finished the transaction online.

spanish.definition: Acto de comprar o vender algo.

definition: A disease that spreads to many people quickly.
examples: There's a flu epidemic this winter.
The epidemic killed thousands.
Obesity has become an epidemic.

spanish.definition: Enfermedad que se propaga rápido a mucha gente.

definition: Causing great damage.
examples: It was the most destructive storm in years.
He has some destructive habits.
War is very destructive.

spanish.definition: Que causa mucho daño.

definition: A river fish that people eat.
examples: We caught three trout in the river.
I ordered the grilled trout.
This lake is full of trout.

spanish.definition: Pez de río que la gente come.

definition: Connected to books and writing.
examples: She won a literary prize.
He works as a literary agent.
We went to a literary festival.

spanish.definition: Relacionado con los libros y la escritura.

definition: An amount that is too much.
examples: Cut off the excess fat from the meat.
He paid a fee for excess baggage.
Drinking to excess is dangerous.

spanish.definition: Cantidad que es demasiada.

definition: The state of having no job; the number of people with no job.
examples: Unemployment is high in this area.
He's been on unemployment since March.
The government wants to reduce unemployment.

spanish.definition: Estado de no tener trabajo; número de personas sin trabajo.

definition: Trash left on the ground; a group of baby animals born together.
examples: There's a lot of litter in the park.
Our dog had a litter of six puppies.
The sign says no litter on the beach.

spanish.definition: Basura dejada en el suelo; grupo de animales bebés nacidos juntos.
